title: Item grants: F3 owned-entity lifecycle and F2 control hooks not landed; persistent-actor runtimeOwner not enforced
description: olc5.12.1 follow-up. Grant clauses carry F3 encounter/persistent/owned-entity lifecycle, F2 controlled-entity command budget, and F5 owned-entity identity hooks. None is landed. Control and obedience stay DM-adjudicated. Also, grants with runtimeOwner persistent-actor (Ring of Djinni, Efreeti Bottle, Feather Token whip, Manual of Golems, Staff of the Python, Iron Flask, Figurines not included) bind without campaignActorId, so combat closure may release the link. Decide whether persistent-actor requires a durable campaign actor before landing F3.
notes:
olc5.12.2 (commit b205724d): persistent-actor grants now require campaignActorId (or a campaign-actor combatant) on each linked actor, so combat closure rebinds rather than releases the summon. Closure does NOT end the effect (probed); it released the link and left the effect active with no creature. F3/F2/F5 owned-entity hooks remain unlanded. Discrepancy: the pack lists figurine grants as persistent-actor, which was applied.
